subjects.name: Mara
subjects.description: Adult woman with short wavy brown hair and an ochre raincoat

place.description: A misty harbour at dusk: a wet wooden pier with a dark railing.

shots.description: Mara walks steadily along the wet pier, the railing on her left.
Mara keeps walking; she is small in the frame at the railing. Wide static reverse angle from the water. Camera position: Out on the water, looking back at the pier.
shots.screen_direction: Seen from the water, she walks from screen right to screen left.

shots.description: Mara keeps walking, closer now, the town lights behind her. Medium shot from the water side. Camera position: On the water, closer to the pier.
shots.screen_direction: She still walks from screen right to screen left.
